I farm here in Amhara on my own land, and this small plot of 0.69 hectares I am keeping for something other than my main grain. I have no schooling but I know this soil from many years. Fertilizer from the shop is very expensive and the rains have been uncertain, so I will use only a little DAP at planting and put the manure from my cattle on this plot because it is close to the homestead. I use my own seed saved from last year, and for weeding I rely on my wife, my older children and myself with the hoe; I will only hire a few neighbors for the busy weeding and harvest days.
